IN THE COURT OF SPECIAL JUDGE (NDPS),
SHAHDARA, KARKARDOOMA COURTS, DELHI
Criminal Revision No. JMFC
(Mahila Court-01), Shahdara District, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi in FIR No. Trial Court is well reasoned and should not be interfered with in revision petition. Thus, the act
of the revisionists/ accused persons must fall within the ambit of sub-clause (i) of sub-section (1) of
Section 354D IPC. Thus, the essential ingredients to prove offence punishable U/s 354D IPC in the
(a) The man accused follows a woman, and
(b) Contacts or attempts to contacts such woman;
(c) To foster personal interaction;
(d) repeatedly;
(e) despite a clear indication of disinterest by such woman. Thus, from the
allegations leveled by the complainant and victims ingredients to constitute offence punishable U/s
354D IPC are not made out. Thus, offence U/s 354D IPC is not made out against revisionists/ accused
persons. Thus, the revisionists/ accused persons are accordingly, discharged qua offence punishable
U/s 354D IPC. Trial Court is partially
modified/ partially set-aside in respect of offence punishable U/s 354D IPC. Copy of this judgment alongwith
Trial Court Record be sent back to the Ld. Trial Court for information and proceeding further, as per
law.
